image_description: A low-angle, upward-looking shot of a staircase interior under dramatic blue lighting. The primary subject is a dark wooden bannister system featuring a continuous handrail and vertical balusters ascending diagonally from the bottom left. In the background, there is a landing with glass-paned doors or windows emitting bright light, contrasting with the deep blue walls. A smoke detector is visible on the ceiling.
